# Performance Checklist: SPEC-014 Control-Flow Graphs

**Purpose**: Validate that SPEC-014 performance requirements are complete, precise, consistent, and measurable before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-07-25
**Feature**: ../spec.md

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Index-Time Budget

- [x] CHK001 Is the enabled CFG analysis overhead budget quantified as paired-median index-time ratio `<= 1.20` against the same project with CFG disabled? [Clarity, Spec FR-032, Spec SC-009, Plan Performance Goals]
- [x] CHK002 Are disabled and enabled benchmark arms explicitly defined against the same committed benchmark-monorepo fixture? [Completeness, research.md Decision 6, Plan Performance and Reliability]
- [x] CHK003 Are warmup pairs, measured pairs, alternating arm order, clean `.codegraph/` materialization, recorded medians, min/max, sample count, warmup count, and ratio required? [Measurability, Plan Performance and Reliability]
- [x] CHK004 Are hardware/runtime/fixture identity and CI-reduced sample rules specified objectively enough to make the benchmark reproducible and non-flaky? [Completeness, Plan Performance and Reliability, quickstart.md Self-Repo UAT]

## Disabled Dormancy

- [x] CHK005 Are disabled CFG analysis requirements complete for zero network calls, zero CFG status/block/edge writes, no changed read behavior, and no persisted setting changes except explicit enablement/disablement? [Completeness, Spec FR-002, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK006 Are disabled sync and reads required to suppress retained rows instead of making stale/retained rows visible or current? [Consistency, Spec FR-006, data-model.md State Transitions]
- [x] CHK007 Are success criteria measurable for zero disabled CFG writes and unchanged non-CFG behavior? [Acceptance Criteria Quality, Spec SC-001]

## Resource Bounds

- [x] CHK008 Is the 10,000-block per-function cap specified before any CFG payload rows are written? [Clarity, Spec FR-017, Plan Performance and Reliability, research.md Decision 7]
- [x] CHK009 Are over-cap functions required to persist `resource_limited` with `block_limit_exceeded` and expose no partial CFG? [Consistency, Spec FR-017, contracts/cfg-shared-contract.md Expected State and Reason Mapping]
- [x] CHK010 Are library, CLI, and MCP read outputs bounded by deterministic `limit` and `offset` defaults/clamps? [Completeness, Spec FR-028, Spec FR-029, Plan Public Surfaces]
- [x] CHK011 Are independent block and edge page windows specified so large valid CFGs reconstruct without overlap or gaps? [Acceptance Criteria Quality, Spec FR-029, Spec SC-007]

## Incremental Work And Cancellation

- [x] CHK012 Is affected-file CFG rebuild required instead of full project recompute on every sync, with first-enable backfill as the exception? [Clarity, Spec FR-003, Spec FR-004, Plan Scale/Scope]
- [x] CHK013 Are unchanged functions protected from stale status caused by unrelated project writes? [Measurability, Spec FR-015, research.md Decision 3]
- [x] CHK014 Are cooperative cancellation and yield points specified for long CFG lowering, including file/function boundaries and before the final atomic swap? [Completeness, Spec FR-009, Plan Performance and Reliability]
- [x] CHK015 Are cancellation outcomes measurable as no partial writes before swap and committed result standing after swap? [Acceptance Criteria Quality, Spec FR-009, data-model.md State Transitions]

- [x] CHK017 Does Slice 2 require the same performance gate with Python parity included in final cross-language benchmark evidence? [Traceability, Plan Slice 2 Verification Gates]
